name: lace_holes
description: a glowing lace web of fine strands pierced by round holes of every size, each rim a bright thread and each hole a lit glass bead; one stack in each kept map
notes: Merged (item 041, under 038's palette-set rule): 037's four kept lace styles are one stack in four maps. The stack is the `bubbles` formulation round one kept (bead_strands' structure: an inverted `inside` rim glow and a `light` on `inside` doming every hole as a glass bead), cream_lace's numbers its default; copper_mail, gold_arcs and bead_strands differ from it only in numbers and colours, carried as their entries' values. Two keeps (cream_lace's `current` formulation, copper_mail's basilica2_value location) were drawn with the five-layer stack before the bubbles; their records hold that stack.
cream_lace: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map cream_lace (blue black, deep teal, steel blue, bronze to cream and ivory), the strands at the steel blue and the cream, holes pure black.

copper_mail: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map copper_mail (maroon brown, rust, copper to amber and pale gold), ground at gamma 2.5 so the strands read, the map's top held at a muted copper and the holes a mid brown: dragon-mail's p90 is 0.528, and with a pale gold top every render missed it by 0.2; the tone pass then flattens the holes towards the lace's tone.

gold_arcs: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map gold_arcs (olive umber, burnt orange, amber, gold, butter yellow), the brightest reference (median 0.547), holes an amber brown rather than dark, as the reference's are.

bead_strands: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map bead_strands (violet black, indigo, periwinkle, to ice blue at its top), every hole a glass bead: an inverted `inside` glow at power 6 and a light domed on `inside`, its highlight the map's periwinkle at 0.85.

Lessons: item 037 brought five references whose look is a glowing lace web of fine strands pierced by round holes of every size (devilfish, dreaming, dragon-mail, flamed, deepsea-life, all -25.jpg), and they went in as **four on one stack; bead_strands adds an inside rim glow and the bead light**. **The holes are the set's interior**, and the galleries have none to offer: a hole probe (the interior white, the rest black) read 0.000 on every Julia seat of a 60-seat scout, and of 150 plane seats only phoenix-classic held interior, which reads as whirls. So the seats are hand-placed Julia sets of z^d + c at the centre of a hyperbolic component (Newton on f^p(0) = 0), whose Fatou components are round discs at every scale: whole sets and the framings where holes of many sizes meet; the pinwheels at a repelling fixed point have holes too big. **Strands that hug the set**: the stripe average's crests at density 2 and 4 (a glow at power 10, flame_wisp_waves), masked by the inverted `de` at power 1 to 3, so they feather out of the lace round each hole and die into the ground; 032's strands ignored the set because nothing tied them to it. The ground is the smooth count by rank at gamma 2 to 5, dark, so the strands carry the lace; at gamma 1 the near-set band is one flat cream fill. The interior paint wants pure black on the dark references: the tone pass lifts a dark navy hole to slate. `inside` read as a palette at three cycles is a bullseye in every hole (the `inner` formulation keeps it at 0.12); an inverted `inside` glow at power 16 is invisible, at 6 a soft inner rim, and a `light` on `inside` at one band with `rings` 1 domes each component as a lit glass bead (bead_strands' default, the `bubbles` formulation elsewhere). Round one is drawn at --draft (about 2 s a frame at six threads).
Item 050: the engine now keeps one stripe sum per density, so the density-4 strands draw as written for the first time (they drew at 2 before); every keep was redrawn.

knobs.name: light_angle
knobs.label: Light direction
knobs.what: where the light on the glass beads comes from, in degrees round the frame (135 is the upper left)

knobs.name: bead_gloss
knobs.label: Bead gloss
knobs.what: how tight and glassy the shine on each bead is, from a broad soft sheen to a small sharp spark

knobs.name: rim_glow
knobs.label: Hole rim glow
knobs.what: how far the glow inside each hole's rim reaches towards its centre

knobs.name: strands
knobs.label: Strand strength
knobs.what: how thick and bright the fine strands of the lace web are

knobs.name: strand_fade
knobs.label: Strand fade
knobs.what: how quickly the strands fade into the dark as they leave the lace
